checks.method: Kato analytic perturbation theory (isolated simple ground E0(0)=0, gap 3, bounded V); psi_1 = K^{-1}(W_1+W_2) = (W_1+W_2)/3 exactly because span{x,y} is the exact K-eigenspace at 3; so d<W>/dtau_FG|_0 = 2<x, psi_1> = 2 E[x^2]/3 = 1/6 with zero omitted-space tail

checks.derivation: on |tau|<=3/8 (complex) the Riesz projection P(tau) around |z|=3/2 has ||P||<=1/(1-4|tau|/3)<=2 and |Tr(H P)|<=3; Cauchy: |a_n|<=2(8/3)^n, |e_n|<=3(8/3)^n; the odd/even parts of the certified +-h enclosures then enclose a_1, a_2, e_2
